_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::cardiovascular0d#2. Cavity 0 of upstream cardiovascular0d_4elementwindkessel_structure_direct_genalpha is DSURFACE 3 = all eight nodes of the first HEX8, the closed boundary of a 10x10x10 cube; 4C prints '0 V:' near -1.0e+03 each step and the run exits 0 with three result tests correct. Dropping nodes 5..8 leaves one face and the printed volume becomes -1.6666666666666666e+02 and never changes (OPEN_DISTINCT_CAVITY0_VOLUMES=1) -- exactly (1/3)*(-5)*100, the divergence-theorem integral over the single remaining face, a sixth of the truth and constant, so the 0D model sees a rigid cavity. NOX then gives up with 'The nonlinear solver did not converge!' from solver_nonlin_nox/4C_solver_nonlin_nox_problem.cpp and no result test runs; nothing in that message mentions the cavity surface (OPEN_CAVITY_DIAGNOSTICS=0). Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: The nonlinear solver did not converge!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep the cavity boundary closed in the OPEN arm. The volume goes back to ~-1.0e+03 and varies per step, NOX converges, EXIT_OPEN becomes 0 and the fixture must go red.
